```text
459	                            >
460	                              {visualKind === "direct" ? (
461	                                <CliBrandIcon workerType={run.preferredWorkerType ?? null} className={run.preferredWorkerType === "opencode" ? "h-3 w-3" : "h-3.5 w-3.5"} />
462	                              ) : (
463	                                <ConversationIcon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
464	                              )}
465	                            </span>
466	                            {renamingRunId === run.id && renameSource !== "topbar" ? (
467	                              <Input
468	                                value={renameValue}
469	                                onChange={(event) => setRenameValue(event.target.value)}
470	                                onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
471	                                onKeyDown={(event) => {
472	                                  event.stopPropagation();
473	                                  if (event.key === "Enter") {
474	                                    event.preventDefault();
475	                                    commitRenamingRun(run.id);
476	                                  } else if (event.key === "Escape") {
477	                                    event.preventDefault();
478	                                    cancelRenamingRun();
479	                                  }
480	                                }}
481	                                onBlur={() => commitRenamingRun(run.id)}
482	                                autoFocus
483	                                className="h-7 min-w-0 text-[13px]"
484	                              />
485	                            ) : (
486	                              <span className="truncate text-[13px]">{run.title}</span>
487	                            )}
488	                          </div>
489	                          <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
490	                            {run.status === "running" ? (
491	                              <LoaderCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin text-muted-foreground motion-reduce:animate-none" />
492	                            ) : null}
493	                            {runIsUnread && !showCompletedAttentionIndicator ? (
494	                              <div className="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-blue-500" />
495	                            ) : null}
496	                            {canArchiveConversation && isCommitConversation ? (
497	                              <Button
498	                                variant="ghost"
499	                                size="icon"
500	                                className="h-6 w-6 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground opacity-100 hover:text-foreground lg:opacity-0 lg:group-hover:opacity-100"
501	                                aria-label={t("conversation.sidebar.archiveConversation", { title: run.title })}
502	                                title={t("conversation.sidebar.archiveConversation", { title: run.title })}
503	                                onClick={(event) => {
504	                                  event.stopPropagation();
505	                                  archiveRun(run);
506	                                }}
507	                              >
508	                                <Archive className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
509	                              </Button>
510	                            ) : null}
511	                            <DropdownMenu>
512	                              <DropdownMenuTrigger
513	                                onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
514	                                className="inline-flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground opacity-100 transition-colors ring-offset-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 lg:opacity-0 lg:group-hover:opacity-100"
515	                                aria-label={t("conversation.sidebar.conversationActions", { title: run.title })}
516	                              >
517	                                <MoreHorizontal className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
518	                              </DropdownMenuTrigger>
519	                              <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="min-w-28">
520	                                <DropdownMenuItem
521	                                  className="cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
522	                                  onClick={(event) => {
523	                                    event.stopPropagation();
524	                                    startRenamingRun(run);
525	                                  }}
526	                                >
527	                                  <Pencil className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" /> {t("conversation.sidebar.rename")}
528	                                </DropdownMenuItem>
529	                                {canMoveConversation ? (
530	                                  <DropdownMenuItem
531	                                    className="cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
532	                                    onClick={(event) => {
533	                                      event.stopPropagation();
534	                                      startMovingRun(run);
535	                                    }}
536	                                  >
537	                                    <FolderInput className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" /> {t("conversation.sidebar.moveToProject")}
538	                                  </DropdownMenuItem>
539	                                ) : null}
540	                                {canArchiveConversation ? (
541	                                  <DropdownMenuItem
542	                                    className="cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
543	                                    onClick={(event) => {
544	                                      event.stopPropagation();
545	                                      archiveRun(run);
546	                                    }}
547	                                  >
548	                                    <Archive className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" /> {t("conversation.sidebar.archive")}
549	                                  </DropdownMenuItem>
550	                                ) : null}
551	                                <DropdownMenuItem
552	                                  variant="destructive"
553	                                  className="cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
554	                                  onClick={(event) => {
555	                                    event.stopPropagation();
556	                                    deleteRun(run);
557	                                  }}
558	                                >
559	                                  <Trash2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" /> {t("conversation.sidebar.delete")}
560	                                </DropdownMenuItem>
561	                              </DropdownMenuContent>
562	                            </DropdownMenu>
563	                          </div>
564	                        </div>
565	                      </div>
566	                    </div>
567	                  );
568	                })}
569	                {hiddenSessionCount > 0 ? (
570	                  <button
571	                    type="button"
572	                    className="ml-7 mt-1 inline-flex h-7 items-center rounded-md px-2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-muted/60 hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
573	                    aria-label={t("conversation.sidebar.showMoreSessions", {
574	                      count: nextSessionBatchCount,
575	                      project: group.name,
576	                    })}
577	                    title={t("conversation.sidebar.showMoreSessions", {
578	                      count: nextSessionBatchCount,
579	                      project: group.name,
580	                    })}
581	                    onClick={() => onShowMoreProjectSessions(group.path)}
582	                  >
583	                    {t("conversation.sidebar.moreSessions")}
584	                  </button>
585	                ) : null}
586	              </div>
587	            </div>
588	          </Collapsible>
589	        );
590	      })}
591	    </>
592	  );
593	}

595	interface MoveRunToProjectDialogProps {
596	  open: boolean;
597	  moveRunProjectPath: string;
598	  moveRunToProjectOptions: string[];
599	  isMoveRunToProjectPending: boolean;
600	  setMoveRunProjectPath: (value: string) => void;
601	  confirmMoveRunToProject: () => void;
602	  cancelMovingRun: () => void;
603	}
604	
605	function MoveRunToProjectDialog({
606	  open,
607	  moveRunProjectPath,
608	  moveRunToProjectOptions,
609	  isMoveRunToProjectPending,
610	  setMoveRunProjectPath,
611	  confirmMoveRunToProject,
612	  cancelMovingRun,
613	}: MoveRunToProjectDialogProps) {
614	  return (
615	    <Dialog
616	      open={open}
617	      onOpenChange={(nextOpen) => {
618	        if (!nextOpen) {
619	          cancelMovingRun();
620	        }
621	      }}
622	    >
623	      <DialogContent showCloseButton={false}>
624	        <DialogHeader>
625	          <DialogTitle>{t("conversation.moveProject.title")}</DialogTitle>
626	          <DialogDescription>
627	            {moveRunToProjectOptions.length > 0
628	              ? t("conversation.moveProject.description")
629	              : t("conversation.moveProject.empty")}
630	          </DialogDescription>
631	        </DialogHeader>
632	        <div className="grid gap-2">
633	          <label className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" htmlFor="move-run-project-select">
634	            {t("conversation.moveProject.projectLabel")}
635	          </label>
636	          <select
637	            id="move-run-project-select"
638	            className="h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 text-sm text-foreground shadow-xs outline-none transition-colors focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
639	            value={moveRunProjectPath}
640	            onChange={(event) => setMoveRunProjectPath(event.target.value)}
641	            disabled={isMoveRunToProjectPending || moveRunToProjectOptions.length === 0}
642	          >
643	            <option value="">{t("conversation.moveProject.placeholder")}</option>
644	            {moveRunToProjectOptions.map((projectPath) => (
645	              <option key={projectPath} value={projectPath}>
646	                {projectPath}
647	              </option>
648	            ))}
649	          </select>
650	        </div>
651	        <DialogFooter>
652	          <Button
653	            type="button"
654	            variant="outline"
655	            onClick={cancelMovingRun}
656	            disabled={isMoveRunToProjectPending}
657	          >
658	            {t("common.cancel")}
659	          </Button>
660	          <Button
661	            type="button"
662	            onClick={confirmMoveRunToProject}
663	            disabled={!moveRunProjectPath || isMoveRunToProjectPending}
664	          >
665	            {t("conversation.moveProject.ok")}
666	          </Button>
667	        </DialogFooter>
668	      </DialogContent>
669	    </Dialog>
670	  );
671	}

726	/**
727	 * Memoized. Every SSE frame gave the shell a new state identity and re-rendered
728	 * this entire subtree, even when nothing it renders had changed. Its props are
729	 * spread from `sharedSidebarProps`, whose callbacks are now stable, so the
730	 * shallow comparison is meaningful.
731	 */
732	const ConversationSidebar = memo(function ConversationSidebar({
733	  filteredProjects,
734	  activeProjects,
735	  conversationSidebarTab,

737	  isHydratingConversations,

753	  beginConversationInProject,

755	  isAutoCommitProjectPending,
756	  handleRemoveProject,
757	  selectRun,
758	  renamingRunId,

760	  renameSource,

774	  deleteRun,
775	  authEnabled,
776	  openPairDeviceDialog,

779	  setThemeMode,
780	  onCollapse,
781	  onOpenExternalSessions,
782	  runnerControlsMode = "desktop",
783	}: ConversationSidebarProps) {
784	  useI18nSnapshot();
785	  const themeModeLabel = t(themeMode === "night" ? "theme.mode.switchDay" : "theme.mode.switchNight");
786	  const visibleProjectGroups = conversationSidebarTab === "projects" ? filteredProjects : activeProjects;
787	  const hasExpandedVisibleProjectGroup = visibleProjectGroups.some((group) => !collapsedProjectPaths.has(group.path));
788	  const mounted = useSyncExternalStore(

790	    useCallback(() => conversationSidebarHydrationManager.getSnapshot(), []),

793	  useEffect(() => {

796	
797	  if (!mounted) {
798	    // First render (SSR + initial client paint) renders an empty shell so the

800	    // list populates from local state after hydration, shifting Base UI's

823	              variant="ghost"

825	              className="hidden h-9 w-9 text-[#333333]/75 transition-all duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-[#deddda] hover:text-[#1f1f1f] lg:inline-flex dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-muted/70 dark:hover:text-zinc-100 motion-reduce:transition-none"
826	              aria-label={t("conversation.sidebar.collapseAria")}
827	              title={t("conversation.sidebar.collapseAria")}
828	              onClick={onCollapse}
829	            >

889	                type="button"
890	                onClick={() => setConversationSidebarTab("recent")}
891	                className={cn(

893	                  conversationSidebarTab === "recent"
894	                    ? "bg-[#deddda] text-[#1f1f1f] dark:bg-white/[0.12] dark:text-zinc-100"
895	                    : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground",
896	                )}
897	              >
898	                {t("conversation.sidebar.tab.active")}
899	              </button>
900	            </div>
901	            <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5">
902	              <Tooltip>
903	                <TooltipTrigger render={<span className="inline-flex" />}>
904	                  <Button
905	                    variant="ghost"
906	                    size="icon"
907	                    className="h-6 w-6 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
908	                    disabled={!hasExpandedVisibleProjectGroup}
909	                    aria-label={t("conversation.sidebar.collapseAllProjects")}
910	                    title={t("conversation.sidebar.collapseAllProjects")}

944	              selectedRunId={selectedRunId}
945	              messages={messages}
946	              readMarkers={readMarkers}
947	              collapsedProjectPaths={collapsedProjectPaths}
948	              visibleProjectSessionCounts={visibleProjectSessionCounts}
949	              canReorderProjects={conversationSidebarTab === "projects"}
950	              onProjectOpenChange={onProjectOpenChange}
951	              onReorderProjects={onReorderProjects}

959	              renameValue={renameValue}
960	              renameSource={renameSource}
961	              setRenameValue={setRenameValue}
962	              startMovingRun={startMovingRun}

966	              archiveRun={archiveRun}

970	          ) : (
971	            <ConversationProjectGroupList
972	              groups={activeProjects}
973	              isHydratingConversations={false}
974	              selectedRunId={selectedRunId}
975	              messages={messages}
976	              readMarkers={readMarkers}
977	              collapsedProjectPaths={collapsedProjectPaths}
978	              visibleProjectSessionCounts={visibleProjectSessionCounts}
979	              canReorderProjects={false}
980	              onProjectOpenChange={onProjectOpenChange}
981	              onReorderProjects={onReorderProjects}
982	              onShowMoreProjectSessions={onShowMoreProjectSessions}
983	              beginConversationInProject={beginConversationInProject}
```

```text
1	// Pure helpers for sidebar activity classification. No React imports.
2	// Used by useHomeViewModel to build the Active tab dataset.
3	
4	import { isTerminalRunStatus, normalizeRunStatus } from "@/lib/run-status";
5	import { isWorkerActiveStatus } from "@/lib/conversation-workers";
6	import { isRunUnread, resolveRunLatestUnreadTimestamp } from "@/lib/conversation-state";
7	import type { SidebarGroup, SidebarRun } from "./types";
8	
9	export const ACTIVE_SESSION_ACTIVITY_WINDOW_MS = 20 * 60 * 1000;
10	
11	function parseTimestampMs(value: string | null | undefined): number {
12	  if (!value) return 0;
13	  const t = new Date(value).getTime();
14	  return Number.isFinite(t) ? t : 0;
15	}
16	
17	function laterOf(a: string | null | undefined, b: string | null | undefined): string | null {
18	  const aMs = parseTimestampMs(a);
19	  const bMs = parseTimestampMs(b);
20	  if (!a && !b) return null;
21	  return aMs >= bMs ? (a ?? null) : (b ?? null);
22	}
23	
24	function maxTimestamp(...values: (string | null | undefined)[]): string | null {
25	  return values.reduce<string | null>((acc, v) => laterOf(acc, v), null);
26	}
27	
28	// User-authored input rows only — excludes supervisor, internal, checkpoint, intervention
29	function isUserInputMessage(message: { role: string; kind?: string | null }): boolean {
30	  if ((message.role ?? "").toLowerCase() !== "user") return false;
31	  const kind = (message.kind ?? "").toLowerCase();
32	  return kind !== "checkpoint" && kind !== "internal" && kind !== "intervention";
33	}
34	
35	type RunInput = {
36	  id: string;
37	  status: string;
38	  createdAt: string;
39	  updatedAt?: string | null;
40	};
41	
42	type WorkerInput = {
43	  id: string;
44	  runId: string;
45	  status: string;
46	  updatedAt?: string;
47	};
48	
49	type AgentInput = {
50	  name: string; // workerId
51	  state: string;
52	  updatedAt?: string;
53	  lastText?: string;
54	  currentText?: string;
55	  displayText?: string;
56	};
57	
58	type MessageInput = {
59	  runId: string;
60	  role: string;
61	  kind?: string | null;
62	  createdAt: string;
63	};
64	
65	type QueuedMessageInput = {
66	  runId: string;
67	  createdAt: string;
68	  updatedAt: string;
69	  deliveredAt?: string | null;
70	};
71	
72	/**
73	 * Per-run rollups computed in ONE pass over each global collection.
74	 *
75	 * Without this, classifying N runs cost N full scans of every message, queued
76	 * message, worker and agent in the app — and the sidebar did that three times
77	 * over on every SSE frame, allocating two `Date` objects per message compared.
78	 * With ~40 runs and a few thousand accumulated messages that is hundreds of
79	 * thousands of iterations per frame, which is what made the sidebar the single
80	 * most expensive thing on the client's main thread while sessions streamed.
81	 *
82	 * Build once with `buildSidebarActivityIndex`, reuse for every run.
83	 */
84	export interface SidebarActivityIndex {
85	  latestMessageAtByRunId: Map<string, string>;
86	  latestUserInputAtByRunId: Map<string, string>;
87	  workersByRunId: Map<string, WorkerInput[]>;
88	  agentsByWorkerId: Map<string, AgentInput>;
89	}
90	
91	export function buildSidebarActivityIndex(args: {
92	  messages: MessageInput[];
93	  queuedMessages: QueuedMessageInput[];
94	  workers: WorkerInput[];
95	  agents: AgentInput[];
96	}): SidebarActivityIndex {
97	  const latestMessageAtByRunId = new Map<string, string>();
98	  const latestUserInputAtByRunId = new Map<string, string>();
99	  const workersByRunId = new Map<string, WorkerInput[]>();
100	  const agentsByWorkerId = new Map<string, AgentInput>();
101	
102	  const keepLater = (map: Map<string, string>, runId: string, value: string | null | undefined) => {
103	    if (!value) return;
104	    const existing = map.get(runId);
105	    if (!existing || parseTimestampMs(value) > parseTimestampMs(existing)) {
106	      map.set(runId, value);
107	    }
108	  };
109	
110	  for (const message of args.messages) {
111	    keepLater(latestMessageAtByRunId, message.runId, message.createdAt);
112	    if (isUserInputMessage(message)) {
113	      keepLater(latestUserInputAtByRunId, message.runId, message.createdAt);
114	    }
115	  }
116	
117	  for (const queued of args.queuedMessages) {
118	    keepLater(
119	      latestUserInputAtByRunId,
120	      queued.runId,
121	      queued.deliveredAt ?? queued.updatedAt ?? queued.createdAt,
122	    );
123	  }
124	
125	  for (const worker of args.workers) {
126	    const bucket = workersByRunId.get(worker.runId);
127	    if (bucket) {
128	      bucket.push(worker);
129	    } else {
130	      workersByRunId.set(worker.runId, [worker]);
131	    }
132	  }
133	
134	  for (const agent of args.agents) {
135	    agentsByWorkerId.set(agent.name, agent);
136	  }
137	
138	  return { latestMessageAtByRunId, latestUserInputAtByRunId, workersByRunId, agentsByWorkerId };
139	}
140	
141	function indexFromArgs(args: {
142	  messages: MessageInput[];
143	  queuedMessages: QueuedMessageInput[];
144	  workers: WorkerInput[];
145	  agents: AgentInput[];
146	}) {
147	  return buildSidebarActivityIndex(args);
148	}
149	
150	/**
151	 * Indexed twin of `getRunLatestUnreadTimestamp` from `@/lib/conversation-state`.
152	 * Same status rules (shared implementation), no per-run message scan.
153	 */
154	export function getIndexedRunLatestUnreadTimestamp(
155	  run: RunInput,
156	  index: SidebarActivityIndex,
157	): string | null {
158	  return resolveRunLatestUnreadTimestamp(run, index.latestMessageAtByRunId.get(run.id) ?? null);
159	}
160	
161	export interface SidebarRunActivityArgs {
162	  run: RunInput;
163	  messages: MessageInput[];
164	  readMarkers: Record<string, string>;
165	  workers: WorkerInput[];
166	  agents: AgentInput[];
167	  queuedMessages: QueuedMessageInput[];
168	  workerOutputObservedAtByRunId: Record<string, string>;
169	  nowMs: number;
170	  selectedRunId?: string | null;
171	}
172	
173	// recentActivityAt: max of eligible user-input and worker-output signals
174	export function getSidebarRunLastActivityAt(args: SidebarRunActivityArgs): string | null {
175	  return getIndexedSidebarRunLastActivityAt(args, indexFromArgs(args));
176	}
177	
178	function getIndexedSidebarRunLastActivityAt(
179	  args: Pick<SidebarRunActivityArgs, "run" | "workerOutputObservedAtByRunId">,
180	  index: SidebarActivityIndex,
181	): string | null {
182	  const userInputAt = index.latestUserInputAtByRunId.get(args.run.id) ?? null;
183	  const workerOutputAt = args.workerOutputObservedAtByRunId[args.run.id] ?? null;
184	  return maxTimestamp(userInputAt, workerOutputAt);
185	}
186	
187	function getIndexedWorkingActivityAt(run: RunInput, index: SidebarActivityIndex): string | null {
188	  const runWorkers = index.workersByRunId.get(run.id) ?? [];
189	  const timestamps: (string | null | undefined)[] = [run.updatedAt];
190	
191	  for (const worker of runWorkers) {
192	    if (isWorkerActiveStatus(worker.status)) {
193	      timestamps.push(worker.updatedAt);
194	    }
195	    const agent = index.agentsByWorkerId.get(worker.id);
196	    if (agent && isWorkerActiveStatus(agent.state)) {
197	      timestamps.push(agent.updatedAt);
198	    }
199	  }
200	
201	  timestamps.push(run.createdAt);
202	  return maxTimestamp(...timestamps);
203	}
204	
205	export function isSidebarRunCurrentlyWorking(
206	  args: Pick<SidebarRunActivityArgs, "run" | "workers" | "agents">,
207	): boolean {
208	  return isIndexedSidebarRunCurrentlyWorking(args.run, buildSidebarActivityIndex({
209	    messages: [],
210	    queuedMessages: [],
211	    workers: args.workers,
212	    agents: args.agents,
213	  }));
214	}
215	
216	function isIndexedSidebarRunCurrentlyWorking(run: RunInput, index: SidebarActivityIndex): boolean {
217	  // Terminal runs are never "working" — stale worker metadata loses.
218	  if (isTerminalRunStatus(run.status)) return false;
219	
220	  const normalizedStatus = normalizeRunStatus(run.status);
221	  if (normalizedStatus === "needs_recovery") return false;
222	
223	  if (normalizedStatus !== "running" && normalizedStatus !== "awaiting_user") return false;
224	
225	  const runWorkers = index.workersByRunId.get(run.id) ?? [];
226	
227	  for (const worker of runWorkers) {
228	    if (isWorkerActiveStatus(worker.status)) return true;
229	    const agent = index.agentsByWorkerId.get(worker.id);
230	    if (agent && isWorkerActiveStatus(agent.state)) return true;
231	  }
232	
233	  // Run is "running" with no active workers/agents yet — still counts.
234	  return normalizedStatus === "running";
235	}
236	
237	export interface RunActiveClassification {
238	  isActive: boolean;
239	  isUnread: boolean;
240	  isWorking: boolean;
241	  isRecent: boolean;
242	  recentActivityAt: string | null;
243	  activeSortAt: string | null;
244	}
245	
246	export function classifySidebarRun(args: SidebarRunActivityArgs): RunActiveClassification {
247	  return classifyIndexedSidebarRun(args, indexFromArgs(args));
248	}
249	
250	/**
251	 * The hot path. `buildActiveConversationGroups` builds the index once and calls
252	 * this per run, so classification is O(workers in run) instead of O(all
253	 * messages + all workers + all agents).
254	 */
255	export function classifyIndexedSidebarRun(
256	  args: Pick<SidebarRunActivityArgs, "run" | "readMarkers" | "workerOutputObservedAtByRunId" | "nowMs" | "selectedRunId">,
257	  index: SidebarActivityIndex,
258	): RunActiveClassification {
259	  const { run, readMarkers, nowMs } = args;
260	  const lastReadAt = readMarkers[run.id] ?? null;
261	  const normalizedStatus = normalizeRunStatus(run.status);
262	
263	  const latestUnreadAt = getIndexedRunLatestUnreadTimestamp(run, index);
264	  const isUnread = isRunUnread({ latestMessageAt: latestUnreadAt, lastReadAt });
265	
266	  const isWorking = isIndexedSidebarRunCurrentlyWorking(run, index);
267	
268	  const recentActivityAt = getIndexedSidebarRunLastActivityAt(args, index);
269	  const allowsRecentActivity = normalizedStatus !== "cancelled" && normalizedStatus !== "canceled";
270	  const isRecent =
271	    allowsRecentActivity &&
272	    recentActivityAt !== null &&
273	    nowMs - parseTimestampMs(recentActivityAt) <= ACTIVE_SESSION_ACTIVITY_WINDOW_MS;
274	
275	  const isSelected = args.selectedRunId != null && args.run.id === args.selectedRunId;
276	  const isActive = isUnread || isWorking || isRecent || isSelected;
277	
278	  let activeSortAt: string | null = recentActivityAt;
279	  if (isUnread && latestUnreadAt) {
280	    activeSortAt = maxTimestamp(activeSortAt, latestUnreadAt);
281	  }
282	  if (isWorking) {
283	    activeSortAt = maxTimestamp(activeSortAt, getIndexedWorkingActivityAt(run, index));
284	  }
285	  if (!activeSortAt) activeSortAt = run.createdAt;
286	
287	  return { isActive, isUnread, isWorking, isRecent, recentActivityAt, activeSortAt };
288	}
289	
290	export function compareActiveSidebarRunsDesc(
291	  a: { activeSortAt: string | null; createdAt: string; id: string },
292	  b: { activeSortAt: string | null; createdAt: string; id: string },
293	): number {
294	  const diff = parseTimestampMs(b.activeSortAt) - parseTimestampMs(a.activeSortAt);
295	  if (diff !== 0) return diff;
296	  const createdDiff = parseTimestampMs(b.createdAt) - parseTimestampMs(a.createdAt);
297	  if (createdDiff !== 0) return createdDiff;
298	  return a.id < b.id ? -1 : a.id > b.id ? 1 : 0;
299	}
300	
301	export interface BuildActiveGroupsArgs {
302	  groups: SidebarGroup[];
303	  messages: MessageInput[];
304	  readMarkers: Record<string, string>;
305	  workers: WorkerInput[];
306	  agents: AgentInput[];
307	  queuedMessages: QueuedMessageInput[];
308	  workerOutputObservedAtByRunId: Record<string, string>;
309	  nowMs: number;
310	  selectedRunId?: string | null;
311	}
312	
313	export function buildActiveConversationGroups(args: BuildActiveGroupsArgs): SidebarGroup[] {
314	  const { groups, messages, readMarkers, workers, agents, queuedMessages, workerOutputObservedAtByRunId, nowMs, selectedRunId } = args;
315	
316	  const activeGroups: Array<{ group: SidebarGroup; latestActivityMs: number }> = [];
317	
318	  // One pass over the global collections, reused for every run below. This
319	  // replaces N full scans of messages/queued/workers/agents per frame.
320	  const index = buildSidebarActivityIndex({ messages, queuedMessages, workers, agents });
321	
322	  for (const group of groups) {
323	    const activeRuns: Array<SidebarRun & { activeSortAt: string | null }> = [];
324	    let groupLatestMs = 0;
325	
326	    for (const run of group.runs) {
327	      const result = classifyIndexedSidebarRun({
328	        run: {
329	          id: run.id,
330	          status: run.status,
331	          createdAt: run.createdAt,
332	          updatedAt: (run as SidebarRun & { updatedAt?: string | null }).updatedAt ?? null,
333	        },
334	        readMarkers,
335	        workerOutputObservedAtByRunId,
336	        nowMs,
337	        selectedRunId,
338	      }, index);
339	
340	      if (!result.isActive) continue;
341	
342	      activeRuns.push({ ...run, activeSortAt: result.activeSortAt });
343	      const ms = parseTimestampMs(result.activeSortAt);
344	      if (ms > groupLatestMs) groupLatestMs = ms;
345	    }
346	
347	    if (activeRuns.length === 0) continue;
348	
349	    activeRuns.sort(compareActiveSidebarRunsDesc);
350	
351	    activeGroups.push({
352	      group: { path: group.path, name: group.name, runs: activeRuns },
353	      latestActivityMs: groupLatestMs,
354	    });
355	  }
356	
357	  activeGroups.sort((a, b) => {
358	    const diff = b.latestActivityMs - a.latestActivityMs;
359	    if (diff !== 0) return diff;
360	    if (a.group.name < b.group.name) return -1;
361	    if (a.group.name > b.group.name) return 1;
362	    if (a.group.path < b.group.path) return -1;
363	    if (a.group.path > b.group.path) return 1;
364	    return 0;
365	  });
366	
367	  return activeGroups.map((entry) => entry.group);
368	}
369	
370	// Apply search to the active groups.
371	// If the query matches the project name, all active sessions in that project remain visible.
372	// Otherwise filter active sessions whose title or path matches the query.
373	export function filterActiveConversationGroups(
374	  activeGroups: SidebarGroup[],
375	  searchQuery: string,
376	): SidebarGroup[] {
377	  if (!searchQuery) return activeGroups;
378	  const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
379	
380	  return activeGroups
381	    .map((group) => {
382	      if (group.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) {
383	        // Project name matches — show all active sessions in this project.
384	        return group;
385	      }
386	      // Otherwise filter sessions by title or path.
387	      const runs = group.runs.filter(
388	        (run) => run.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || run.path.toLowerCase().includes(q),
389	      );
390	      return { ...group, runs };
391	    })
392	    .filter((group) => group.runs.length > 0);
393	}
```

```text
48	    args.runs.map((run) => run.projectPath),
49	  );
50	  const mappedRuns = args.runs
51	    .map((run) => {
52	      const plan = args.plans.find((candidate) => candidate.id === run.planId);
53	      const planPath = plan?.path ?? run.projectPath ?? run.id;
54	
55	      const projectPath = resolveStoredProjectRoot(run.projectPath, args.explicitProjects, { staleFallbackProject })
56	        ?? (plan ? findMatchingProject(plan.path, args.explicitProjects) : null);
57	      return {
58	        id: run.id,
59	        groupPath: projectPath ? normalizeProjectPath(projectPath) : "other",
60	        title: run.title || "New conversation",
61	        path: planPath,
62	        mode: run.mode,
63	        status: run.status,
64	        createdAt: run.createdAt,
65	        updatedAt: run.updatedAt ?? null,
66	        preferredWorkerType: run.preferredWorkerType,
67	      };
68	    })
69	    .filter((run): run is NonNullable<typeof run> => Boolean(run));
70	
71	  const groups = new Map<string, ConversationGroup>();
72	
73	  for (const normalizedPath of normalizeExplicitProjectPaths(args.explicitProjects)) {
74	    groups.set(normalizedPath, {
75	      path: normalizedPath,
76	      name: normalizedPath.split("/").pop() || normalizedPath,
77	      runs: [],
78	    });
79	  }
80	
81	  for (const run of mappedRuns) {
82	    if (groups.has(run.groupPath)) {
83	      continue;
84	    }
85	
86	    if (run.groupPath === "other") {
87	      groups.set(run.groupPath, {
88	        path: run.groupPath,
89	        name: t("conversation.sidebar.otherSessions"),
90	        runs: [],
91	      });
92	      continue;
93	    }
94	
95	    groups.set(run.groupPath, {
96	      path: run.groupPath,
97	      name: run.groupPath.split("/").pop() || run.groupPath,
98	      runs: [],
99	    });
100	  }
101	
102	  const explicitGroups = Array.from(groups.values()).map((group) => ({
103	    ...group,
104	    runs: mappedRuns
105	      .filter((run) => run.groupPath === group.path)
106	      .map((run) => ({
107	        id: run.id,
108	        title: run.title,
109	        path: run.path,
110	        mode: run.mode,
111	        status: run.status,
112	        createdAt: run.createdAt,
113	        updatedAt: run.updatedAt,
114	        preferredWorkerType: run.preferredWorkerType,
115	      })),
116	  }));
117	
118	  const otherRuns = mappedRuns
119	    .filter((run) => run.groupPath === "other")
120	    .map((run) => ({
121	      id: run.id,
122	      title: run.title,
123	      path: run.path,
124	      mode: run.mode,
125	      status: run.status,
126	      createdAt: run.createdAt,
127	      updatedAt: run.updatedAt,
128	      preferredWorkerType: run.preferredWorkerType,
129	    }));
130	
131	  if (otherRuns.length > 0 && !groups.has("other")) {
132	    explicitGroups.push({
133	      path: "other",
134	      name: t("conversation.sidebar.otherSessions"),
135	      runs: otherRuns,
136	    });
137	  }
138	
139	  return explicitGroups;
140	}
```

```text
25	 * kept.
26	 *
27	 * The server stamps every snapshot with `snapshotChecksum` over the whole
28	 * payload (`server/events/payload-checksum.ts`), so an equal checksum means an
29	 * identical server-side view. Comparing the merged arrays by identity would be
30	 * useless here — a re-delivered payload is a fresh `JSON.parse`, so every array
31	 * is a new object even when byte-identical. The checksum is the only cheap
32	 * signal that actually distinguishes "same data" from "new data".
```

```text
65	type QueuedMessageInput = {
66	  runId: string;

69	  deliveredAt?: string | null;
70	};
71	
72	/**
73	 * Per-run rollups computed in ONE pass over each global collection.
74	 *
75	 * Without this, classifying N runs cost N full scans of every message, queued
76	 * message, worker and agent in the app — and the sidebar did that three times
77	 * over on every SSE frame, allocating two `Date` objects per message compared.
78	 * With ~40 runs and a few thousand accumulated messages that is hundreds of
79	 * thousands of iterations per frame, which is what made the sidebar the single
80	 * most expensive thing on the client's main thread while sessions streamed.
81	 *
82	 * Build once with `buildSidebarActivityIndex`, reuse for every run.
83	 */
84	export interface SidebarActivityIndex {
85	  latestMessageAtByRunId: Map<string, string>;
86	  latestUserInputAtByRunId: Map<string, string>;
87	  workersByRunId: Map<string, WorkerInput[]>;
88	  agentsByWorkerId: Map<string, AgentInput>;
89	}
90	
91	export function buildSidebarActivityIndex(args: {
92	  messages: MessageInput[];
93	  queuedMessages: QueuedMessageInput[];
94	  workers: WorkerInput[];
95	  agents: AgentInput[];
96	}): SidebarActivityIndex {
97	  const latestMessageAtByRunId = new Map<string, string>();
98	  const latestUserInputAtByRunId = new Map<string, string>();
99	  const workersByRunId = new Map<string, WorkerInput[]>();
100	  const agentsByWorkerId = new Map<string, AgentInput>();
101	
102	  const keepLater = (map: Map<string, string>, runId: string, value: string | null | undefined) => {
103	    if (!value) return;
104	    const existing = map.get(runId);
105	    if (!existing || parseTimestampMs(value) > parseTimestampMs(existing)) {
106	      map.set(runId, value);
107	    }
108	  };
109	
110	  for (const message of args.messages) {
111	    keepLater(latestMessageAtByRunId, message.runId, message.createdAt);
112	    if (isUserInputMessage(message)) {
113	      keepLater(latestUserInputAtByRunId, message.runId, message.createdAt);
114	    }
115	  }
116	
117	  for (const queued of args.queuedMessages) {
118	    keepLater(
119	      latestUserInputAtByRunId,
120	      queued.runId,
121	      queued.deliveredAt ?? queued.updatedAt ?? queued.createdAt,
122	    );
123	  }
124	
125	  for (const worker of args.workers) {
126	    const bucket = workersByRunId.get(worker.runId);
127	    if (bucket) {
128	      bucket.push(worker);
129	    } else {
130	      workersByRunId.set(worker.runId, [worker]);
131	    }
132	  }
133	
134	  for (const agent of args.agents) {
135	    agentsByWorkerId.set(agent.name, agent);
136	  }
137	
138	  return { latestMessageAtByRunId, latestUserInputAtByRunId, workersByRunId, agentsByWorkerId };
139	}
140	
141	function indexFromArgs(args: {
142	  messages: MessageInput[];
143	  queuedMessages: QueuedMessageInput[];
144	  workers: WorkerInput[];
145	  agents: AgentInput[];
146	}) {
147	  return buildSidebarActivityIndex(args);
148	}
```

```text
      title: run.title,
      path: run.path,
      mode: run.mode,
      status: run.status,
      createdAt: run.createdAt,
      updatedAt: run.updatedAt,
      preferredWorkerType: run.preferredWorkerType,
    }));

  if (otherRuns.length > 0 && !groups.has("other")) {
    explicitGroups.push({
      path: "other",
      name: t("conversation.sidebar.otherSessions"),
      runs: otherRuns,
    });
  }

  return explicitGroups;
}
```

````text
### 1. **Exact File Locations and Line Numbers for Session Sorting**

  - This returns runs sorted by `createdAt DESC`, then `id DESC` (most recent first)
  - No further sorting occurs in the client-side `buildConversationGroups()` function

- **File:** `/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/lib/conversations.ts`
- **Lines 50-70:** The `buildConversationGroups()` function maps and groups runs but does **NOT** sort them. They maintain the order from the database query.
- **Lines 102-116:** Runs are filtered and grouped by project path with no reordering.

**For the "Recent" (Active) tab:**
- **File:** `/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/interface/home/sidebar-activity.ts`
- **Line 349:** Within each project group, active runs are sorted:
  ```typescript
  activeRuns.sort(compareActiveSidebarRunsDesc);

- **Lines 290-299:** The `compareActiveSidebarRunsDesc()` function defines the sort order:
  ```typescript
  export function compareActiveSidebarRunsDesc(
    a: { activeSortAt: string | null; createdAt: string; id: string },
    b: { activeSortAt: string | null; createdAt: string; id: string },
  ): number {
    const diff = parseTimestampMs(b.activeSortAt) - parseTimestampMs(a.activeSortAt);
    if (diff !== 0) return diff;
    const createdDiff = parseTimestampMs(b.createdAt) - parseTimestampMs(a.createdAt);
    if (createdDiff !== 0) return createdDiff;
    return a.id < b.id ? -1 : a.id > b.id ? 1 : 0;
  }
  ```

### 2. **Current Sort Field**

**Projects Tab:** `createdAt` (descending - most recent created first)
**Recent/Active Tab:** `activeSortAt` (descending), with fallback to `createdAt`, then `id` for tiebreaking

### 3. **Full Shape/Type of Session/Run Object with ALL Available Timestamp Fields**

**Database schema (server-side)** from `/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/server/db/schema.ts` lines 11-46:

```typescript
export const runs = sqliteTable('runs', {
  // ... non-timestamp fields ...
  failedAt: integer('failed_at', { mode: 'timestamp' }),           // When run failed
  archivedAt: integer('archived_at', { mode: 'timestamp' }),       // When archived
  lastMemoryConsolidationAt: integer('last_memory_consolidation_at', { mode: 'timestamp' }), // Last memory consolidation
  createdAt: integer('created_at', { mode: 'timestamp' }).notNull(),  // Created timestamp
  updatedAt: integer('updated_at', { mode: 'timestamp' }).notNull(),  // Last update timestamp
});
```

**TypeScript type for sidebar** from `/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/shared/home-types.ts` lines 421-430:

```typescript
export type SidebarRun = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  path: string;
  mode?: RunMode | null;
  status: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt?: string | null;
  preferredWorkerType?: WorkerType | null;
};
```

**All timestamp-ish fields available in the broader RunRecord** (lines 45-73):
- `createdAt` (required)
- `updatedAt` (optional, can be null)
- `failedAt` (optional, when run failed)
- `archivedAt` (optional, when archived)
- `lastMemoryConsolidationAt` (optional, last memory consolidation)

**Runtime-computed timestamps used for "Active" tab sorting** from `/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/interface/home/sidebar-activity.ts`:
- `latestMessageAtByRunId` - Latest message createdAt per run (line 85)
- `latestUserInputAtByRunId` - Latest user-authored message createdAt per run (line 86)
- `activeSortAt` - Composite timestamp for activity-based sorting (line 278-285)
- `recentActivityAt` - Maximum of user input and worker output timestamps (line 268)

### 4. **Existing "Last Activity" / "Last Message Time" Notion in Codebase**

**YES - Multiple existing patterns exist:**

1. **`latestMessageAtByRunId`** (sidebar-activity.ts:85, 111)
   - Tracks the latest message timestamp per run
   - Computed in `buildSidebarActivityIndex()` by scanning all messages

2. **`latestUserInputAtByRunId`** (sidebar-activity.ts:86, 113-123)
   - Tracks latest user-authored input (excludes checkpoint/internal/intervention messages)
   - Includes queued messages with deliveredAt timestamp

3. **`getSidebarRunLastActivityAt()`** (sidebar-activity.ts:174-185)
   - Merges user input and worker output activity
   - Returns max timestamp of these two signals

4. **`getIndexedWorkingActivityAt()`** (sidebar-activity.ts:187-203)
   - Tracks activity for runs currently working
   - Uses `run.updatedAt`, active worker `updatedAt`, and agent `updatedAt`

5. **`activeSortAt`** (sidebar-activity.ts:278-285)
   - Multi-signal sort key used for the Recent tab
   - Composites: recentActivityAt, unread timestamp, and working activity timestamp
   - Falls back to `run.createdAt` if no activity exists

### 5. **Data Source: Where Session List Data Comes From**

**Server-side generation:**
- **Source:** SQLite database (persisted locally)
- **Query file:** `/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/server/events/persisted-snapshot.ts:238`
- **Endpoint:** HTTP route that serves the event stream (fetches all non-archived runs)

**Client-side processing:**
- **Fetched by:** `useHomeViewModel()` hook in `/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/interface/home/useHomeViewModel.ts:195-199`
- **Groups built:** `buildConversationGroups()` (no additional sorting)
- **Active groups computed:** `buildActiveConversationGroups()` (applies activity-based filtering and sorting)

**Timestamp persistence:**
- **`createdAt`/`updatedAt`:** Persisted server-side in `runs` table
- **`latestMessageAt`/`latestUserInputAt`:** Derived client-side from `messages`, `workers`, and `queuedMessages` arrays in the event stream
- **`activeSortAt`:** Computed entirely client-side in `classifyIndexedSidebarRun()` based on activity signals
- **`recentActivityAt`:** Computed client-side from `workerOutputObservedAtByRunId` (tracked by `SidebarWorkerActivityManager`)

---

**Key Finding:** The "Projects" tab shows sessions in database creation order (newest first), while the "Recent" tab dynamically sorts by composite activity signals that blend message recency, worker status, and unread state. There is NO explicit "lastActivityAt" field stored in the database—activity is computed on-the-fly from message and worker timestamps.
````

## Claude subagent agent-a5eaa7fe55df2c09f: Claude · 2026-08-07T11:41:05.987Z

````text
Perfect! Now I have all the information I need. Let me compile a comprehensive report.

## Comprehensive Analysis: Event/Message Model for Conversation Sessions

Based on my thorough exploration of the codebase, here's what marks turn completion, message persistence, and the event stream infrastructure:

---

### 1. **AGENT TURN COMPLETION / "worker_turn_completed" EVENT**

**Where turns are marked complete:**
- **Event Type Definition**: `/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/server/supervisor/observer.ts:33`
  - Constant: `WORKER_TURN_COMPLETED_EVENT_TYPE = "worker_turn_completed"`

**Turn completion detection logic** (`observer.ts:600-617`):
```typescript
if (!completionHintNotified && (completedByAcpState || longCompletionText)) {
  events.push({
    type: WORKER_TURN_COMPLETED_EVENT_TYPE,
    summary: completedByAcpState
      ? `${args.workerId} completed a worker turn`
      : `${args.workerId} produced a long final-looking text turn`,
    shouldWakeSupervisor: true,
    updatesActivity: false,
  });
  completionHintNotified = true;
}
```

**Execution Event Recording** (`observer.ts:726-789`):
The `insertExecutionEvent` function records "worker_turn_completed" to the database:
- Records to `executionEvents` table with: `eventType: "worker_turn_completed"`
- Stored via `/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/server/events/execution-event-store.ts:91-151`
  - **Timestamp recorded**: `createdAt: new Date()` (line 93) — the current moment when event is recorded
  - **Deduplication**: Prevents duplicate "worker_turn_completed" events for the same prompt (line 732-737)

**Alternative recovery path** (`stuck-worker-reaper.ts:267`):
- In recovery scenarios, a "worker_turn_completed" event can be synthesized when a lost completion is detected after the worker goes idle 5+ minutes.

---

### 2. **USER MESSAGE PERSISTENCE & TIMESTAMPS**

**Message Table Schema** (`/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/server/db/schema.ts:112-123`):
```typescript
export const messages = sqliteTable('messages', {
  id: text('id').primaryKey(),
  runId: text('run_id').references(() => runs.id).notNull(),
  role: text('role').notNull(), // 'user', 'supervisor', 'worker'
  kind: text('kind'),
  content: text('content').notNull(),
  attachmentsJson: text('attachments_json'),
  workerId: text('worker_id').references(() => workers.id),
  supersededAt: integer('superseded_at', { mode: 'timestamp' }),
  editedFromMessageId: text('edited_from_message_id'),
  createdAt: integer('created_at', { mode: 'timestamp' }).notNull(),
});
```

**User message recording examples**:

1. **Direct worker elicitation answer** (`send-message.ts:155-229`):
   ```typescript
   const createdAt = new Date();
   const userMessage = {
     id: args.messageId,
     runId: args.run.id,
     role: "user",
     kind: "checkpoint",
     content: args.userText,
     attachmentsJson: args.attachmentsJson,
     createdAt,
   };
   await db.insert(messages).values(userMessage);
   ```

2. **Standard queued message delivery** (`queued-messages.ts:647-665`):
   ```typescript
   const deliveredAt = new Date();
   // ... insert user message into DB
   await db.insert(messages).values(userMessage);
   // ... update queue status
   await db.update(queuedConversationMessages).set({
     status: "delivered",
     updatedAt: deliveredAt,
     deliveredAt,
   }).where(eq(queuedConversationMessages.id, messageId));
   ```

**Serialization** (`message-records.ts:14-24`):
Messages are converted to ISO strings when sent to clients:
```typescript
export function serializeMessageRecord(message: SerializableMessageRecord | null | undefined) {
  return {
    ...message,
    createdAt: message.createdAt.toISOString(),
    attachments: parseChatAttachmentsJson(message.attachmentsJson),
  };
}
```

**Type Definition** (`/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/shared/home-types.ts:84-94`):
```typescript
export type MessageRecord = {
  id: string;
  runId: string;
  role: string;
  kind?: string | null;
  content: string;
  workerId?: string | null;
  attachments?: ChatAttachment[];
  attachmentsJson?: string | null;
  createdAt: string;  // ISO timestamp
};
```

---

### 3. **PERSISTENCE LAYER & SESSION METADATA**

**Database**: SQLite (all schema in `/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/server/db/schema.ts`)

**Runs Table** (`schema.ts:11-46`):
```typescript
export const runs = sqliteTable('runs', {
  id: text('id').primaryKey(),
  // ... other fields
  status: text('status').notNull(),  // 'running', 'done', 'failed'
  createdAt: integer('created_at', { mode: 'timestamp' }).notNull(),
  updatedAt: integer('updated_at', { mode: 'timestamp' }).notNull(),
});
```

**Activity Tracking**:
- **`runs.updatedAt`** is bumped whenever a message is sent or a turn completes (e.g., `send-message.ts:203-208`)
  ```typescript
  await db.update(runs).set({
    status: "running",
    failedAt: null,
    lastError: null,
    updatedAt: createdAt,  // ← Timestamp of user message
  }).where(eq(runs.id, args.run.id));
  ```

**Queued Messages Table** (`schema.ts:132-144`):
```typescript
export const queuedConversationMessages = sqliteTable('queued_conversation_messages', {
  id: text('id').primaryKey(),
  runId: text('run_id').references(() => runs.id).notNull(),
  targetWorkerId: text('target_worker_id').references(() => workers.id),
  action: text('action').notNull(),  // 'queue' | 'steer'
  content: text('content').notNull(),
  attachmentsJson: text('attachments_json'),
  status: text('status').notNull(),  // 'pending', 'delivering', 'delivered', 'cancelled', 'failed'
  lastError: text('last_error'),
  createdAt: integer('created_at', { mode: 'timestamp' }).notNull(),
  updatedAt: integer('updated_at', { mode: 'timestamp' }).notNull(),
  deliveredAt: integer('delivered_at', { mode: 'timestamp' }),  // ← Timestamp when delivered
});
```

**Workers Table** (`schema.ts:48-85`):
- **`workers.updatedAt`** tracks when worker status changes (e.g., transitions from idle → working → idle after turn completion)
- **`turnGeneration`**: Monotonic fence incremented on turn interruption; prevents stale completions from persisting if turn was abandoned
- **`activeWorkStartedAt`** / **`activeWorkDurationMs`**: Timestamps for work duration tracking

---

### 4. **EVENT STREAM & CLIENT NOTIFICATION**

**Named Events** (`/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/server/events/named-events.ts`):

Key event types relevant to turns:
- `"worker.status"` (line 254): `{ runId, workerId, prev: string, next: string }` — fired when worker status changes
- `"worker.spawned"` (line 253): New worker created
- Supervisor-specific: `"supervisor.wake_lease_acquired"`, `"supervisor.durable_wake_claimed"`, etc.

**Execution Events** (`execution-event-store.ts:91-151`):
- Persisted to both artifact stream (JSONL) and `executionEvents` SQLite table
- Each event has a `createdAt` timestamp (defaults to `new Date()`)
- Envelope structure (line 109-116):
  ```typescript
  const envelope: ArtifactRecordEnvelope = {
    id,
    seq,
    runId: input.runId,
    kind: "execution_events",
    createdAt: createdAt.toISOString(),  // ← ISO string timestamp
    payload,
  };
  ```

**Event Stream API Response** (`/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/runtime/http/routes/events.ts`):

1. **Snapshot Response** (lines 778-843):
   - `/api/events?snapshot=1` returns full `EventStreamState` (defined in `home-types.ts:353-398`)
   - Response header: `x-omni-last-event-id` (line 837)
   - Response header: `x-omni-snapshot-checksum` (line 839)

2. **Server-Sent Events (SSE) Stream** (lines 845-1024+):
   - Persistent HTTP connection with named events + snapshot updates
   - Frame format (line 870-872):
     ```
     id: <streamId>
     event: <eventType>
     data: <JSON>
     ```
   - Event types in stream:
     - `"update"` (line 954): Full snapshot payload
     - `"stream.resync_required"` (line 912): Cursor evicted from ring buffer
     - `"auth.session_revoked"` (line 891): Session invalidated
     - Named events (e.g., `"worker.status"`, `"worker_turn_completed"`) drained via `drainBufferedEvents()` (lines 901-926)

3. **Message Scope in Snapshots** (lines 541-544):
   ```typescript
   messageScope: {
     runIds: messageRunIds,
     complete: true,
   }
   ```

4. **Queued Messages in Snapshot** (lines 525-527):
   ```typescript
   queuedMessages: records.allQueuedMessages
     .filter((message) => message.status === "pending" || message.status === "delivering")
     .map(serializeQueuedConversationMessage),
   ```

**EventStreamState Type** (`home-types.ts:353-398`):
```typescript
export type EventStreamState = {
  messages: MessageRecord[];
  readMarkers?: Record<string, string>;
  plans: PlanRecord[];
  runs: RunRecord[];
  sessions?: SessionRecord[];
  accounts: AccountRecord[];
  agents: AgentSnapshot[];
  workers: ConversationWorkerRecord[];
  planItems: PlanItemRecord[];
  clarifications: ClarificationRecord[];
  executionEvents: ExecutionEventRecord[];
  supervisorInterventions: SupervisorInterventionRecord[];
  queuedMessages?: QueuedConversationMessageRecord[];  // ← Pending/delivering user messages
  recoveryIncidents?: RecoveryIncidentRecord[];
  recoveryState?: RunRecoveryState | null;
  reviewRuns?: PlanningReviewRunRecord[];
  reviewRounds?: PlanningReviewRoundRecord[];
  reviewFindings?: PlanningReviewFindingRecord[];
  frontendErrors?: AppErrorPayload[];
  snapshotRunId?: string | null;
  snapshotChecksum?: string;  // ← Checksum prevents duplicate updates
  snapshotSource?: "cache" | "optimistic" | "server";
  messageScope?: { runIds: string[]; complete: boolean };
  snapshotScope?: { catalog?: { complete: boolean }; executionEvents?: { ... }; };
  workerEntrySeqs?: Record<string, number>;
  workerEntries?: Record<string, WorkerEntry[]>;
  claudeModelGateway?: ClaudeModelGatewayStatus;
};
```

---

### 5. **TURN COMPLETION LIFECYCLE SUMMARY**

**High-level flow:**

1. **User sends message** → Inserted into `messages` table with `createdAt: new Date()`
2. **Message delivered to worker** → `queuedConversationMessages` status transitions: `pending` → `delivering` → `delivered` (with `deliveredAt` timestamp)
3. **Worker processes & generates output** → Observable via worker output stream (per-worker JSONL entries)
4. **Supervisor observer polls worker state** (every ~5 seconds, `observer.ts:28`)
5. **Turn completion detected** (line 607-617):
   - When worker reaches ACP-compatible terminal state (`completedByAcpState`)
   - OR produces unusually long final text (`longCompletionText`)
6. **"worker_turn_completed" execution event recorded** (line 779-786):
   - Appended to artifact stream + SQLite `executionEvents` table
   - **Timestamp recorded**: `createdAt` defaults to `new Date()` when recording
7. **Client receives update**:
   - Via SSE stream: Named event or full snapshot
   - Event appears in `EventStreamState.executionEvents[]` array
   - Client UI reflects turn completion state

**Timestamp Recording Points:**
- User message: **`messages.createdAt`** (message send time)
- Queued message delivery: **`queuedConversationMessages.deliveredAt`** (when pushed to worker)
- Queued message tracking: **`queuedConversationMessages.updatedAt`** (lifecycle updates)
- Turn completion event: **`executionEvents.createdAt`** (when supervisor observer detected completion)
- Run activity: **`runs.updatedAt`** (bumped on message send or turn completion)
- Worker activity: **`workers.updatedAt`** (bumped on status changes including post-turn idle)

---

### **Key Files for Reference:**

1. `/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/server/db/schema.ts` — Complete schema including `messages`, `queuedConversationMessages`, `executionEvents`, `runs`, `workers` tables
2. `/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/server/supervisor/observer.ts` — Turn completion detection logic
3. `/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/server/events/execution-event-store.ts` — Event persistence (artifact + DB dual-write)
4. `/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/runtime/http/routes/events.ts` — Event stream API endpoint
5. `/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/server/conversations/queued-messages.ts` — Message queueing & delivery lifecycle
6. `/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/shared/home-types.ts` — EventStreamState type definition
7. `/Users/masterman/NLP/omniharness/src/server/events/named-events.ts` — Named event type definitions
````

```text
255	export function classifyIndexedSidebarRun(

257	  index: SidebarActivityIndex,

259	  const { run, readMarkers, nowMs } = args;

274	
275	  const isSelected = args.selectedRunId != null && args.run.id === args.selectedRunId;
276	  const isActive = isUnread || isWorking || isRecent || isSelected;

290	export function compareActiveSidebarRunsDesc(
291	  a: { activeSortAt: string | null; createdAt: string; id: string },
292	  b: { activeSortAt: string | null; createdAt: string; id: string },
293	): number {

295	  if (diff !== 0) return diff;
296	  const createdDiff = parseTimestampMs(b.createdAt) - parseTimestampMs(a.createdAt);
297	  if (createdDiff !== 0) return createdDiff;

313	export function buildActiveConversationGroups(args: BuildActiveGroupsArgs): SidebarGroup[] {
314	  const { groups, messages, readMarkers, workers, agents, queuedMessages, workerOutputObservedAtByRunId, nowMs, selectedRunId } = args;
315	
316	  const activeGroups: Array<{ group: SidebarGroup; latestActivityMs: number }> = [];
317	
318	  // One pass over the global collections, reused for every run below. This
319	  // replaces N full scans of messages/queued/workers/agents per frame.
320	  const index = buildSidebarActivityIndex({ messages, queuedMessages, workers, agents });
321	
322	  for (const group of groups) {
323	    const activeRuns: Array<SidebarRun & { activeSortAt: string | null }> = [];
324	    let groupLatestMs = 0;
325	
326	    for (const run of group.runs) {
327	      const result = classifyIndexedSidebarRun({
328	        run: {
329	          id: run.id,
330	          status: run.status,
331	          createdAt: run.createdAt,
332	          updatedAt: (run as SidebarRun & { updatedAt?: string | null }).updatedAt ?? null,
333	        },
334	        readMarkers,
335	        workerOutputObservedAtByRunId,
336	        nowMs,
337	        selectedRunId,
338	      }, index);
339	
340	      if (!result.isActive) continue;
341	
342	      activeRuns.push({ ...run, activeSortAt: result.activeSortAt });
343	      const ms = parseTimestampMs(result.activeSortAt);
344	      if (ms > groupLatestMs) groupLatestMs = ms;
345	    }
346	
347	    if (activeRuns.length === 0) continue;
348	
349	    activeRuns.sort(compareActiveSidebarRunsDesc);
350	
351	    activeGroups.push({
352	      group: { path: group.path, name: group.name, runs: activeRuns },
353	      latestActivityMs: groupLatestMs,
354	    });
355	  }
356	
357	  activeGroups.sort((a, b) => {
358	    const diff = b.latestActivityMs - a.latestActivityMs;
359	    if (diff !== 0) return diff;
360	    if (a.group.name < b.group.name) return -1;
361	    if (a.group.name > b.group.name) return 1;
362	    if (a.group.path < b.group.path) return -1;
363	    if (a.group.path > b.group.path) return 1;
364	    return 0;
365	  });
366	
367	  return activeGroups.map((entry) => entry.group);
368	}
369	
370	// Apply search to the active groups.
371	// If the query matches the project name, all active sessions in that project remain visible.
372	// Otherwise filter active sessions whose title or path matches the query.
373	export function filterActiveConversationGroups(
374	  activeGroups: SidebarGroup[],
375	  searchQuery: string,
376	): SidebarGroup[] {
377	  if (!searchQuery) return activeGroups;
378	  const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
379	
380	  return activeGroups
381	    .map((group) => {
382	      if (group.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) {
383	        // Project name matches — show all active sessions in this project.
384	        return group;
385	      }
386	      // Otherwise filter sessions by title or path.
387	      const runs = group.runs.filter(
388	        (run) => run.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || run.path.toLowerCase().includes(q),
389	      );
390	      return { ...group, runs };
391	    })
392	    .filter((group) => group.runs.length > 0);
393	}
```

```text
91	      });
92	      continue;
93	    }

95	    groups.set(run.groupPath, {
96	      path: run.groupPath,
97	      name: run.groupPath.split("/").pop() || run.groupPath,
98	      runs: [],
99	    });
100	  }
101	
102	  const explicitGroups = Array.from(groups.values()).map((group) => ({
103	    ...group,
104	    runs: mappedRuns
105	      .filter((run) => run.groupPath === group.path)
106	      .map((run) => ({
107	        id: run.id,
108	        title: run.title,
109	        path: run.path,
110	        mode: run.mode,
111	        status: run.status,
112	        createdAt: run.createdAt,

114	        preferredWorkerType: run.preferredWorkerType,
115	      })),
116	  }));
117	
118	  const otherRuns = mappedRuns
119	    .filter((run) => run.groupPath === "other")

121	      id: run.id,
122	      title: run.title,
123	      path: run.path,

126	      createdAt: run.createdAt,
127	      updatedAt: run.updatedAt,
128	      preferredWorkerType: run.preferredWorkerType,
129	    }));

131	  if (otherRuns.length > 0 && !groups.has("other")) {
132	    explicitGroups.push({
133	      path: "other",
134	      name: t("conversation.sidebar.otherSessions"),
135	      runs: otherRuns,
136	    });
137	  }
138	
139	  return explicitGroups;
```

## Claude thinking · 2026-08-07T11:41:22.038Z

For the Projects tab, I need to figure out the right sorting approach. Sessions come from the DB ordered by createdAt, but the user wants them sorted by the most recent timestamp—either when an agent turn finalized or when a user sent a message, whichever is later. Using `runs.updatedAt` could work since it's persisted server-side and available in SidebarRun, but it gets updated for various reasons like status changes and memory consolidation, which might make the ordering feel off. A cleaner approach would be to compute this client-side using the `latestMessageAtByRunId` that's already calculated.

```text
74	          controller.abort();

514	    sessions,
515	    accounts: records.allAccounts.map(toAccountDto),
516	    agents: agentsData.map(compactAgentSnapshot),
517	    workers: records.allWorkers.map(compactWorkerRecord),
518	    planItems: records.allPlanItems,

523	    supervisorInterventions: records.allSupervisorInterventions

543	      complete: true,
544	    },
545	    // Bounded selected-run collections: list a cursor + completeness

553	      },
554	      executionEvents: {

560	      },
561	      supervisorInterventions: {
562	        limit: SUPERVISOR_INTERVENTION_LIMIT,
563	        complete: records.allSupervisorInterventions.length < SUPERVISOR_INTERVENTION_LIMIT,
564	        oldestCreatedAt: records.allSupervisorInterventions.length > 0
565	          ? records.allSupervisorInterventions[records.allSupervisorInterventions.length - 1]!.createdAt.toISOString()

567	      },
568	      planningReviewFindings: {
569	        limit: PLANNING_REVIEW_FINDING_LIMIT,
570	        complete: records.allReviewFindings.length < PLANNING_REVIEW_FINDING_LIMIT,
571	        oldestCreatedAt: records.allReviewFindings.length > 0
572	          ? records.allReviewFindings[records.allReviewFindings.length - 1]!.createdAt.toISOString()

574	      },

576	    workerEntrySeqs,
577	    claudeModelGateway,

581	async function buildPersistedEventPayload(options: EventPayloadOptions = {}, probe?: { mark: (label: string) => void }) {
582	  const records = await readPersistedEventRecords(options, probe);
583	  probe?.mark("readRecords.total");
584	  const scopedWorkers = selectedRunWorkers(records, options);
585	  const workerEntrySeqs = await buildWorkerEntrySeqs(scopedWorkers);
586	  probe?.mark(`workerSeqs[${scopedWorkers.length}]`);
587	  const payload = buildEventPayload(
588	    records,
589	    buildLiveWorkerSnapshots({
590	      workers: scopedWorkers,
591	      runs: records.allRuns,
592	    }),
593	    undefined,
594	    options,
595	    workerEntrySeqs,
596	  );
597	  probe?.mark("buildPayload");
598	  return payload;
599	}

601	type EventPayloadCacheEntry = {
602	  version: number;
603	  promise: Promise<EventPayload>;
604	};
605	
606	const cachedPersistedPayloads = new Map<string, EventPayloadCacheEntry>();
607	const cachedRuntimePayloads = new Map<string, EventPayloadCacheEntry>();
608	
609	export function __clearEventPayloadCachesForTests() {
610	  cachedPersistedPayloads.clear();
611	  cachedRuntimePayloads.clear();
612	}
613	
614	function eventPayloadCacheKey(options: EventPayloadOptions = {}) {
615	  return options.selectedRunId?.trim() || "__all__";
616	}
617	
618	function shareInFlightEventPayload(
619	  cache: Map<string, EventPayloadCacheEntry>,
620	  options: EventPayloadOptions,
621	  build: () => Promise<EventPayload>,
622	) {
623	  const key = eventPayloadCacheKey(options);
624	  const version = getEventStreamNotificationVersion();
625	  const existing = cache.get(key);
626	  if (existing?.version === version) {
627	    return existing.promise;
628	  }
629	
630	  const pending = build().catch((error) => {
631	    const cached = cache.get(key);
632	    if (cached?.promise === pending) {
633	      cache.delete(key);
634	    }
635	    throw error;
636	  });
637	  cache.set(key, { version, promise: pending });
638	  pruneEventPayloadCache(cache);
639	  return pending;
640	}
641	
642	function pruneEventPayloadCache(cache: Map<string, EventPayloadCacheEntry>) {
643	  while (cache.size > EVENT_PAYLOAD_CACHE_LIMIT) {
644	    const oldestKey = cache.keys().next().value;
645	    if (!oldestKey) {
646	      return;
647	    }
648	    cache.delete(oldestKey);
649	  }
650	}
651	
652	function buildSharedPersistedEventPayload(options: EventPayloadOptions = {}, probe?: { mark: (label: string) => void }) {
653	  return shareInFlightEventPayload(
654	    cachedPersistedPayloads,
655	    options,
656	    () => buildPersistedEventPayload(options, probe),
657	  );
658	}

660	async function buildRuntimeEnrichedEventPayload(options: EventPayloadOptions = {}, probe?: { mark: (label: string) => void }) {
661	  let records = await readPersistedEventRecords(options, probe);
662	  probe?.mark("readRecords#1.total");
663	  let scopedWorkers = selectedRunWorkers(records, options);
664	  let workerEntrySeqs = await buildWorkerEntrySeqs(scopedWorkers);
665	  probe?.mark(`workerSeqs#1[${scopedWorkers.length}]`);
666	  let agentsData = buildLiveWorkerSnapshots({
667	    workers: scopedWorkers,
668	    runs: records.allRuns,
669	  });
670	  const frontendErrors: AppErrorPayload[] = [];
671	
672	  try {
673	    const res = await fetchWithTimeout(`${BRIDGE_URL}/agents`, RUNTIME_AGENT_TIMEOUT_MS);
674	    probe?.mark("bridge.fetch");
675	    if (res.ok) {
676	      const rawAgentsPayload = await res.json();
677	      const rawAgents = Array.isArray(rawAgentsPayload) ? rawAgentsPayload : [];
678	      const { syncConversationSessions } = await import("@/server/conversations/sync");
679	      await syncConversationSessions(rawAgents, {
680	        selectedRunId: options.selectedRunId,
681	        refreshPlanningArtifacts: false,
682	      });
683	      probe?.mark("bridge.sync");
684	      // Second reconciliation pass — this one knows what's actually in
685	      // the bridge, so it can detect workers that were "working" when
686	      // the bridge died and are now stranded with no live agent. The
687	      // earlier pass (inside readPersistedEventRecords) couldn't see
688	      // this because it ran before we fetched the bridge agent list.
689	      const bridgeAgentNames = new Set<string>();
690	      for (const agent of rawAgents) {
691	        if (typeof agent === "object" && agent !== null) {
692	          const name = (agent as { name?: unknown }).name;
693	          if (typeof name === "string" && name.length > 0) {
694	            bridgeAgentNames.add(name);
695	          }
696	        }
697	      }
698	      await reconcilePersistedReloadZombies({
699	        selectedRunId: options.selectedRunId,
700	        source: "events-snapshot-post-bridge",
701	        bridgeAgentNames,
702	      });
703	      probe?.mark("reconcile.bridge-orphans");
704	      records = await readPersistedEventRecords(options);
705	      probe?.mark("readRecords#2.total");
706	      scopedWorkers = selectedRunWorkers(records, options);
707	      workerEntrySeqs = await buildWorkerEntrySeqs(scopedWorkers);
708	      probe?.mark(`workerSeqs#2[${scopedWorkers.length}]`);
709	      agentsData = buildLiveWorkerSnapshots({
710	        agents: filterRuntimeAgentsForWorkers(rawAgents, scopedWorkers),
711	        workers: scopedWorkers,
712	        runs: records.allRuns,
713	      });
714	    } else {
715	      const bridgeError = new Error(`Agent runtime list request failed with status ${res.status}.`);
716	      agentsData = buildLiveWorkerSnapshots({
717	        workers: scopedWorkers,
718	        runs: records.allRuns,
719	        bridgeError,
720	      });
721	      if (!isTransientSupervisorError(bridgeError)) {
722	        frontendErrors.push(buildAppError(
723	          bridgeError,
724	          {
725	            source: "Agent runtime",
726	            action: "Stream live agent state",
727	          },
728	        ));
729	      }
730	    }
731	  } catch (error) {
732	    agentsData = buildLiveWorkerSnapshots({
733	      workers: scopedWorkers,
734	      runs: records.allRuns,
735	      bridgeError: error,
736	    });
737	    if (!isTransientSupervisorError(error)) {
738	      frontendErrors.push(buildAppError(error, {
739	        source: "Agent runtime",
740	        action: "Stream live agent state",
741	      }));
742	    }
743	  }
744	
745	  return buildEventPayload(records, agentsData, frontendErrors, options, workerEntrySeqs);
746	}

748	function buildSharedRuntimeEnrichedEventPayload(options: EventPayloadOptions = {}, probe?: { mark: (label: string) => void }) {
749	  return shareInFlightEventPayload(
750	    cachedRuntimePayloads,
751	    options,
752	    () => buildRuntimeEnrichedEventPayload(options, probe),
753	  );
754	}
755	
756	function delay(ms: number) {
757	  return new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
758	}
759	
760	function parseLastEventId(raw: string | null | undefined): number | string | null {
761	  if (!raw) {
762	    return null;
763	  }
764	  const trimmed = raw.trim();
765	  if (!trimmed) {
766	    return null;
767	  }
768	  if (parseEventStreamId(trimmed)) {
769	    return trimmed;
770	  }
771	  if (/^\d+$/.test(trimmed)) {
772	    const parsed = Number(trimmed);
773	    return Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) ? parsed : null;
774	  }
775	  return null;
776	}

778	export const handleEventsRequest: OmniHttpHandler = async (request, context) => {
779	  const url = new URL(request.url);
780	  const isSnapshot = url.searchParams.get("snapshot") === "1";
781	  const persistedOnly = url.searchParams.get("persisted") === "1";
782	  const probe = isSnapshot
783	    ? startSlowProbe(`GET /api/events?snapshot=1${persistedOnly ? "&persisted=1" : ""}${url.searchParams.get("runId") ? `&runId=${url.searchParams.get("runId")}` : ""}`)
784	    : null;
785	  const ticketAuth = isSnapshot
786	    ? null
787	    : await redeemStreamTicketRequest(request, "/api/events");
788	  if (ticketAuth?.response) {
789	    probe?.end();
790	    return ticketAuth.response;
791	  }
792	  const auth = ticketAuth
793	    ? { session: null, response: null }
794	    : await requireApiSession(request, {
795	      source: "Events",
796	      action: "Stream live updates",
797	    });
798	  probe?.mark("auth");
799	  if (auth.response) {
800	    probe?.end();
801	    return auth.response;
802	  }
803	
804	  const eventPayloadOptions = {
805	    selectedRunId: url.searchParams.get("runId"),
806	  } satisfies EventPayloadOptions;
807	
808	  if (isSnapshot) {
809	    const payload = persistedOnly
810	      // `persisted=1` is the canonical verification surface used after
811	      // lifecycle mutations. It must reflect SQLite now, even when a route
812	      // bundle did not share the in-process notification version.
813	      ? await buildPersistedEventPayload(eventPayloadOptions, probe ?? undefined)
814	      : await (async () => {
815	        const { ensureSupervisorRuntimeStarted } = await import("@/server/supervisor/runtime-watchdog");
816	        await ensureSupervisorRuntimeStarted();
817	        probe?.mark("ensureSupervisor");
818	        return buildSharedRuntimeEnrichedEventPayload(eventPayloadOptions, probe ?? undefined);
819	      })();
820	    probe?.mark("payload.total");
821	    const requestedChecksum = url.searchParams.get("checksum")?.trim() || "";
822	
823	    // Anchor the snapshot to the current cursor so a subsequent SSE
824	    // connection can pass `Last-Event-ID: <lastEventId>` (or
825	    // `?lastEventId=`) and receive only events newer than this body.
826	    // Exposed as a response header to avoid changing the JSON shape
827	    // that the UI consumes.
828	    const response = Response.json(
829	      requestedChecksum && requestedChecksum === payload.snapshotChecksum
830	        ? {
831	          notModified: true,
832	          snapshotChecksum: payload.snapshotChecksum,
833	          workerEntrySeqs: payload.workerEntrySeqs,
834	        }
835	        : payload,
836	    );
837	    response.headers.set("x-omni-last-event-id", getEventStreamCursor());
838	    if (payload.snapshotChecksum) {
839	      response.headers.set("x-omni-snapshot-checksum", payload.snapshotChecksum);
840	    }
841	    probe?.end();
842	    return response;
843	  }
844	
845	  const { ensureSupervisorRuntimeStarted } = await import("@/server/supervisor/runtime-watchdog");
846	  await ensureSupervisorRuntimeStarted();
847	
848	  const lastEventIdHeader = request.headers.get("last-event-id");
849	  const resumeFromHeader = parseLastEventId(lastEventIdHeader);
850	  const hasCursorQuery = url.searchParams.has("cursor");
851	  const resumeFromCursorQuery = parseLastEventId(url.searchParams.get("cursor"));
852	  const resumeFromLegacyQuery = parseLastEventId(url.searchParams.get("lastEventId"));
853	  const resumeFromId = hasCursorQuery
854	    ? resumeFromCursorQuery
855	    : resumeFromHeader ?? resumeFromLegacyQuery;
856	  const runIdScope = eventPayloadOptions.selectedRunId ?? null;
857	  const authenticatedSessionId = ticketAuth?.session?.id ?? auth.session?.id ?? null;
858	
859	  let streamClosed = false;
860	  let unsubscribeRevocation: (() => void) | null = null;
861	  const stream = createBoundedByteStream({
862	    async start(controller) {
863	      const encoder = new TextEncoder();
864	      let lastUpdatePayload = "";
865	      let lastDeliveredId = resumeFromId ?? getEventCursor();
866	      // Cursor tracking the highest id we've already streamed to this
867	      // client; used to drain only newly-buffered named events on each
868	      // poll iteration without re-emitting events we already replayed.
869	
870	      const writeFrame = (id: string, event: string, serializedData: string) => {
871	        if (!controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(
872	          `id: ${id}\nevent: ${event}\ndata: ${serializedData}\n\n`,
873	        ))) {
874	          streamClosed = true;
875	        }
876	      };
877	      // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
878	      const sendEvent = (event: string, data: any, id: string) => {
879	        writeFrame(id, event, JSON.stringify(data));
880	      };
881	      if (authenticatedSessionId) {
882	        unsubscribeRevocation = subscribeAuthSessionRevocations((revocation) => {
883	          if (
884	            revocation.sessionIds === null
885	            || revocation.sessionIds.has(authenticatedSessionId)
886	          ) {
887	            const marker = recordSnapshotMarker(
888	              getEventStreamNotificationVersion(),
889	              runIdScope,
890	            );
891	            sendEvent("auth.session_revoked", {
892	              kind: "auth.session_revoked",
893	              reason: revocation.reason,
894	            }, marker.streamId);
895	            lastDeliveredId = marker.id;
896	            streamClosed = true;
897	            controller.close();
898	          }
899	        });
900	      }
901	      const drainBufferedEvents = (options: { throughId?: number | null } = {}) => {
902	        const replay = getNamedEventsSince(lastDeliveredId, {
903	          runId: runIdScope,
904	          throughId: options.throughId,
905	        });
906	        if (replay.resyncRequired) {
907	          const marker = recordSnapshotMarker(
908	            getEventStreamNotificationVersion(),
909	            runIdScope,
910	          );
911	          sendEvent(
912	            "stream.resync_required",
913	            { reason: replay.resyncReason ?? "cursor_evicted" },
914	            marker.streamId,
915	          );
916	          lastDeliveredId = marker.id;
917	          return;
918	        }
919	        for (const entry of replay.events) {
920	          if (entry.event.kind === "snapshot.marker") {

922	          }
923	          writeFrame(entry.streamId, entry.event.kind, JSON.stringify(entry.event));
924	          lastDeliveredId = entry.id;
925	        }

928	        const serializedPayload = JSON.stringify(payload);
929	        if (serializedPayload === lastUpdatePayload) {
```
